charge_description: Having deficient weights in their custody
raw_record: Summary conviction of Messrs Holt and Company of the township of Whitby for having in their custody 13 x 56-pound weights, five 28-pound weights, one 14-pound weight, two seven-pound weights, and one three-and-a-half-pound weight, all of which were deficient in weight. Offence committed at Whitby on 26 April 1818. Case heard at a Petty Sessions for the division of Whitby Strand.
